text: I understand your frustration and I want to help you get this resolved quickly. Since I'm unable to authenticate your identity with the information provided, and you need assistance today, I'll transfer you to a human agent who can better assist you with your exchange request.
zh: 我理解您的沮丧，并且我想帮助您快速解决这个问题。由于我无法通过您提供的信息验证您的身份，并且您今天需要帮助，我会将您转接给一位能够更好地协助您处理换货请求的人工客服。
